description: Stage-wide maximal does not apply in a nested query. With maximal in %ambiguity-resolution and [+T], the query of maximal-terminator-nested holds, since no T is written (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy maximal
%rule text A B
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r y [+T] B
%rule y A | A B
